from typing import List

class Solution:
    def eraseOverlapIntervals(self, intervals: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        i = 0
        overlap = 0
        length = len(intervals)
        intervals.sort(key=lambda intervals : intervals[1])
        while True:
            j = i + 1
            if j >= length:
                return overlap
            if intervals[j][0] < intervals[i][1]:
                overlap += 1
                intervals.pop(j)
                i -= 1
                length -= 1
            i += 1
